context: A boss reviews a trade-show plan with his manager
purpose: Teach: 出展/移譲/監修/補欠/採点/燃焼/立証/責務

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今回の出展計画、ざっと目を通したが、規模が前回より大きいな。
lines.en: I skimmed the exhibition plan this time. The scale is bigger than last time.
lines.style: Boss speaking plainly, evaluating with measured authority and slight concern.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品を全力でアピールしたいので、ブースも二倍に広げました。
lines.en: Yes. I want to promote the new product with full force, so I doubled the booth size.
lines.style: Manager responding with confident energy and clear commitment to results.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 意気込みは買うが、現場運営の権限はどこまで君に移譲すればいい?
lines.en: I appreciate the drive, but how much on-site authority should I delegate to you?
lines.style: Boss probing with controlled skepticism, testing the subordinate's plan.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 実務は私が仕切り、技術面は開発部長の監修を受ける形で進めます。
lines.en: I'll run operations, and we'll proceed under the development director's technical supervision.
lines.style: Manager explaining the structure clearly, demonstrating thorough preparation and respect.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: なるほど。ただ、登壇者が当日体調を崩した場合の補欠は確保してあるのか?
lines.en: I see. But have you secured a backup speaker in case the presenter falls ill on the day?
lines.style: Boss acknowledging then probing further with sharp managerial foresight.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 営業二課の山田を控えに立てておりますので、その点はご安心ください。
lines.en: I've placed Yamada from Sales Two on standby, so please rest assured on that point.
lines.style: Manager replying smoothly, showing detailed contingency planning and competence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 効果測定はどうする?来場者アンケートの採点基準まで詰めてあるんだろうな。
lines.en: What about measuring impact? You've worked out the visitor survey scoring criteria, I hope.
lines.style: Boss pressing on metrics with weight of accountability behind his words.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい、定量項目と自由記述で配点を分け、商談化率まで追跡する設計です。
lines.en: Yes, we split points between quantitative items and free responses, tracking lead conversion too.
lines.style: Manager answering with composed precision, demonstrating analytical readiness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: よろしい。投資に見合うリターンを立証できなければ来年は縮小だぞ。
lines.en: Good. If you can't prove returns matching the investment, next year shrinks.
lines.style: Boss delivering firm warning with the weight of accountability behind his words.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 承知しております。完全燃焼で成果を出すのが私の責務ですので、必ずやり遂げます。
lines.en: Understood. Giving my all to deliver results is my duty, and I will see it through.
lines.style: Manager accepting responsibility with formal resolve and quiet determination.
